author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: round head with two outward-curling antennae, a body that widens under the head and tapers to a pointed sting, two stripes making three bands, and a wing lobe swept out from each side; mirrored about x=24. A first candidate failed: its wing tips overshot x=6 and the sting triangle was an undersized hole, so the head moved to the top edge to give the sting more height. The rejected drawing read as a striped bell with hooked antennae.
omissions: The antennae curl outward instead of rising above the head (the head uses the top edge so both stripes and the sting fit), and the separate sting line becomes the pointed tip of the body.
drawing_plan: Mirrored about x=24: head r5 at (24,11); body knots (20,14),(17,18),(15,25),(17,33),(24,42); stripes y=25 and y=33; wing lobes from (17,18) to tip x=6 and back to the stripe-1 ends.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'bee': round head, antenna curls, banded body, side wings.
